art_direction: 穿整齐蓝色睡衣的小新坐在窗台软垫上，望着月亮和浅蓝夜空。
composition_variation: Create a soft colored-pencil nighttime illustration of Shinnosuke Nohara sitting on a wide cushioned window seat, quietly looking upward at a crescent moon. Dress him completely in loose blue pajamas and striped socks, with no exposed torso. His recognizable eyebrows and profile appear in a gentle three-quarter angle. A small star-patterned pillow rests beside him. Use midnight blue, periwinkle, soft cream moonlight, a narrow glowing window frame, and subtle paper texture for a peaceful bedtime atmosphere. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
